description: This line plot illustrates the progression of next-token prediction accuracy for two experimental conditions, labeled “Ex1 Accuracy” and “Ex2 Accuracy,” over training steps, as part of the RedWhale Korean LLM continual pretraining study. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” spans from 0 to 600,000 in linear increments of 100,000, with major gridlines at each 100,000-step interval. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction),” ranges from 0.10 to 0.40 in increments of 0.05, with a highlighted reference line at 0.40. The “Ex1 Accuracy” line, rendered in solid blue with circular markers, begins near 0.10 at step 0, rises sharply to approximately 0.23 by step 10,000, then continues to climb more gradually, reaching about 0.38 by step 600,000. The “Ex2 Accuracy” line, shown in solid teal with circular markers, starts at 0.09 at step 0, jumps to 0.22 by step 10,000, and then increases steadily to approximately 0.37 by step 600,000. Both lines exhibit a steep initial rise followed by a slower, sustained increase, with Ex1 consistently outperforming Ex2 across all measured steps.
